check.scope: Exact over every five-word GF(8) input. Ratios, final ranks, retained branch bits b0/b4, and tag do not always recover b1; the compact-state low row is needed by this decoder route.

decision: The ratios, final ranks, retained branch bits b0/b4, and one-bit tag do not determine b1. The candidate eraser must use the compact-state low row or a different reversible state.
